product_one_liner.value: Naïve deploys autonomous AI employees to execute business tasks for people starting new companies or automating existing ones.
product_one_liner.notes: Naïve describes deploying AI employees that execute work, serving both new companies and existing businesses automating functions. Sources: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive and https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/OTnFKjw-founding-member-of-technical-staff-rl

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page lists paid plans and usage pricing. Source: https://usenaive.ai/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Naïve's recruiting page says it is deployed at companies including Airwallex and Hackerrank, identifying them as users rather than investors or partners. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/OTnFKjw-founding-member-of-technical-staff-rl | named_customers.0: Airwallex is explicitly named among companies using Naïve. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/OTnFKjw-founding-member-of-technical-staff-rl | named_customers.1: Hackerrank is explicitly named among companies using Naïve. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/OTnFKjw-founding-member-of-technical-staff-rl

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports a team size of 12, which maps to the requested 11-20 band. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Dealroom explicitly lists San Francisco as headquarters, consistent with the YC company location. The August funding release describes Naïve as Palo Alto-based, creating a location discrepancy and reducing confidence. Sources: https://dealroom.co/companies/na-ve and https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive | hq_country: The company profile explicitly identifies its headquarters as San Francisco, United States. Source: https://dealroom.co/companies/na-ve

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly states Founded: 2025. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive

eng_blog.notes: Under the specified two-engineer-authored-post threshold, the answer is false: the index lists one Engineering post, attributed to Engineering naïve. Other inspected implementation articles are guides or launches without an identified engineer author. This does not mean the blog lacks technical material. Sources: https://usenaive.ai/blogs and https://usenaive.ai/blogs/on-paperclip-and-open-source

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes LLM, SDK/CLI, installation and API material, rather than a single FAQ. Sources: https://usenaive.ai/docs/getting-started/llm, https://usenaive.ai/docs/sdk/overview and https://usenaive.ai/blogs/naive-inside-your-agent-framework

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Applying the question's explicit title-based rule, none of the six listed titles contains the specified AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, scientist, NLP, LLM or computer-vision terms. The board does list Agents and RL technical-staff roles, so this negative is specific to that rule, not a claim that Naïve has no AI-related engineering work. Source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs

model_provider.value: OpenRouter, routing to models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, and Mistral.
model_provider.notes: The product documentation explicitly says its LLM primitive wraps OpenRouter and routes to models from the named providers. This describes supported routing, not a claim that every agent uses every provider. Source: https://usenaive.ai/docs/getting-started/llm

compliance_certs.notes: The security page was inspected and names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as Naïve compliance claims. It refers instead to infrastructure-provider standards and attestations available on request. Source: https://usenaive.ai/security

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest identified round is explicitly described as Series A. Source: https://www.webwire.com/ViewPressRel.asp?aId=358555 | funding_date: The funding release is dated August 6, 2026 and announces the round that day, yielding 2026-08. Source: https://www.webwire.com/ViewPressRel.asp?aId=358555 | funding_amount_usd: The latest identified funding announcement reports a $28.5 million Series A, equivalent to USD 28,500,000. Source: https://www.webwire.com/ViewPressRel.asp?aId=358555

raised_18mo.notes: The $28.5 million Series A announced August 6, 2026 falls within the preceding 18 months. Source: https://www.webwire.com/ViewPressRel.asp?aId=358555

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Direct SDR and Founding Account Executive postings remain accessible with application links and no reported closed notice. They are absent from the main six-role index, so current availability has some uncertainty. Sources: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/vSwqouy-sales-development-representative-sdr and https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive/jobs/atYRN3h-founding-account-executive

launched_6mo.notes: The blog announces Social Data on October 6, 2026, enabling agents to read public social-network data. This is a substantive new capability within the six-month window. Source: https://usenaive.ai/blogs

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small founder-team listing identifies Sean Dorje as CEO and Dennis Zax as CTO. Their profiles place their Naïve starts in April and January 2025, respectively, before the 12-month window; no qualifying departure announcement was found. Changes involving Harmony were excluded as another company. Sources: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/naive, https://linkedin.com/in/seandorje and https://linkedin.com/in/denniszax

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The sales solution page explicitly describes pushing leads, replies and bookings to HubSpot. This establishes a product-integration signal, not proof that HubSpot is Naïve's internal CRM. Source: https://usenaive.ai/solutions/sales | crm_stack_signal.0: HubSpot is explicitly named as a destination for CRM synchronization. Source: https://usenaive.ai/solutions/sales
